backend/main.mo: Implements user signup, admin allowlist checks, role assignment, access control integration, and report storage with system reset functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Contains structured feature evidence metadata mapping features to files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Lists concise summaries of various frontend files describing styling, components, hooks, pages, and utilities.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Documentation outlining deployment procedures, differences between upgrades and fresh publishes, and mainnet rollout steps.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes with consistent design tokens.
frontend/index.html: App HTML entry point including metadata and links to generated favicon and app icon assets.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app router handling authentication, profile detection, session validation, and routing to all pages.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Component displaying an admin-only access restriction message with a button to return home.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Header showing branding, navigation, user ID, admin-only links, and logout functionality with responsive dropdown menu.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Provides the main page layout with header, content area, and footer. Wraps all children components in a consistent visual structure.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Renders login UI using Internet Identity with sign‑up, login, and stale-session recovery options. Handles login triggers and account switching.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Displays the signup form for engineers and admins with validation and role‑based handling. Submits profile data through signup mutations and shows errors.
frontend/src/components/SessionInvalidSc: Shows a session‑invalid message and provides a button to fully log out and retry authentication. Used when a stale or invalid identity is detected.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor tied to the current identity, refetching dependent queries when the actor changes. Initializes admin access when applicable.
frontend/src/hooks/useFullLogout.ts: Implements a complete logout flow by clearing Internet Identity, session storage, React Query cache, and reloading the page.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, handling login, identity loading, logout, and status tracking. Wraps the app with an authentication provider.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains React Query hooks for user profile, admin checks, and signup mutations. Interacts with the backend actor and handles signup debugging and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup defining light and dark theme CSS variables and global styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, query client, Internet Identity provider, and rendering the root component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminUsersPage.tsx: Admin interface for viewing, deleting, and managing users, including purge and system reset operations with permission checks.
frontend/src/pages/ReportDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a single service report with status, metadata, and sections for customer and machine details.
frontend/src/pages/ReportEntryPage.tsx: Form for creating a new service report with validation, submission handling, and success feedback.
frontend/src/pages/ReportHistoryPage.tsx: Lists and filters service reports with search, date filtering, admin user filtering, and CSV export.
frontend/src/utils/authErrorDetection.ts: Utilities to detect missing-profile situations and distinguish real authentication errors from non-auth failures.
frontend/src/utils/authSessionCleanup.ts: Clears stored Internet Identity and delegation data from localStorage and sessionStorage to reset auth state.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Utility that shortens a principal ID for display while preserving key characters.
frontend/src/utils/reportDownload.ts: Converts DailyServiceReport data to CSV and triggers a browser download with a generated filename.
Parses and sanitizes backend signup errors into user-friendly messages, handling common failure cases.
frontend/src/utils/signupFlowDebug.ts: Provides sanitized error logging and safe debug utilities for the signup flow, redacting sensitive data.
frontend/src/utils/signupValidation.ts: Contains basic validation helpers for required fields, email format, and mobile number rules.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Manages URL parameter extraction and persistence using sessionStorage, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration defining theme extensions, custom colors, animations, and plugin setup.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking features, requirements, and branding-related tasks for the Hans Laser logo integration.
